exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of fetal cardiac anomalies
outcome: Concordance between prenatal and postnatal cardiac anomaly diagnoses
cohort: 188 fetuses diagnosed prenatally with cardiac anomalies at Cukurova University, who were delivered and admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit between January 2016 and December 2021.
finding: A high concordance (88.8%) was found between prenatal and postnatal echocardiography findings for cardiac anomalies, and parental consanguinity, gestational age at birth, birth weight, APGAR scores, and chromosomal anomaly assessment significantly influenced neonatal survival.
followup_time: Until the end of the neonatal period
